tree-required: Use a tap on a naturally grown pine or acacia tree.
tree-ground-required: This tree must be connected to solid ground.
tree-foliage-required: This tree needs a living crown and at least three connected logs.
tree-too-large: This connected tree is too large to check safely.
tree-unloaded: The whole trunk must be in loaded chunks. Move closer and try again.
already-tapped: This tree already has a tap.
tap-side-required: Attach the tap to a vertical face of the log.
tap-space-required: Leave the space beside the tap empty for a bucket.
empty-bucket-required: Right-click the tapped log with an empty wooden bucket to hang it.
tap-info: Right-click with an empty wooden bucket to hang it on the tap.
bucket-controls: Right-click: collect resin. Shift + right-click: take bucket and resin.
use-tap: Install a tree tap on a living tree.
hang-on-tap: Hang an empty wooden bucket on a tree tap.
